answer: The grove employs a relic token system with ferrous-osity, a decay mechanism where each agent's identity collateral is represented as a blockchain relic. Ferrous-osity causes tokens to rust (lose value) if unused for extended periods, incentivizing active participation over Sybil farms. Relics are forged through resource-intensive heterogeneous consensus, requiringf ferrous-osity thresholds that increase with network time. Attackers bear economic costs proportional to the ferrous-osity of their fake relics plus computational burdens from short-lived token generation.
